import argparse
import json
import os
import sqlite3
import sys
import hashlib
import hmac
import requests

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('db_path', type=str)
    parser.add_argument('table_name', type=str)
    parser.add_argument('column_name', type=str)
    parser.add_argument('webhook_url', type=str)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    secret = os.getenv('WEBHOOK_SECRET')
    if not secret:
        sys.stderr.write("Error: WEBHOOK_SECRET environment variable not set.\n")
        sys.exit(1)

    conn = sqlite3.connect(args.db_path)
    cursor = conn.cursor()

    ids = []
    for line in sys.stdin:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith('#'):
            continue
        ids.append(line)

    for id in ids:
        query = f"SELECT * FROM {args.table_name} WHERE {args.column_name} = ?"
        cursor.execute(query, (id,))
        row = cursor.fetchone()

        if row is None:
            print(f"{id}: not found")
            continue

        columns = [desc[0] for desc in cursor.description]
        data = dict(zip(columns, row))
        sorted_columns = sorted(data.keys())

        body = json.dumps({k: data[k] for k in sorted_columns}, sort_keys=True)
        signature = hmac.new(
            secret.encode('utf-8'),
            body.encode('utf-8'),
            hashlib.sha256
        ).hexdigest()[:64].lower()

        headers = {'X-Signature': signature}
        try:
            response = requests.post(args.webhook_url, json=data, headers=headers)
            print(f"{id}: {response.status_code}")
        except requests.RequestException:
            print(f"{id}: error")

    conn.close()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
